Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was unhealthy on v2.3.1 (18% error rate) across all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.3.1-rc was staging-only, so it didn't qualify).
2. **Rolled back** all production regions to v2.3.0 — confirmed healthy afterward with error rate down to ~0.2%.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** INC-0002, describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged. (The first attempt timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to avoid duplicates.)
